Maya P.: Quick heads-up — Acme Health kickoff tomorrow 9am PT. We need final alignment on POC success criteria + any enterprise blockers.
Jamal R.: Use cases we committed to: secure clinical summarization + triage routing. Want concrete evals for both.
Alex C.: For summarization: ROUGE + human semantic pass rate. Proposed thresholds: semantic accept >= 85% on 300-case sample. Latency p95 < 300ms for hosted baseline.
Ben L.: Security checklist: VPC peering, KMS key wrap, SOC2 evidence. Also ask if they need HIPAA BA signed — sounds likely.
Sarah T.: Rough timeline: hosted eval + sample prompts live in 48h, Dedicated proof-of-concept (reserved infra, KMS) ~3w. Need legal for BA and IT for peering early.
Jamal R.: For triage routing: precision@1 >= 0.82 on labelled set, false negative rate < 8%. Also need throughput target: 200 qps sustained for peak.
Alex C.: Cost target from procurement: <$0.02 per request on avg. We'll measure tokens/request in eval harness and surface burn. Recommend caching repeated patient templates.
Maya P.: Who signs acceptance? Product + their clinical lead. We should list exact approval criteria in the runbook.
presales-bot: Reminder: attach the security questionnaire PDF to the thread: https://files.redwood/secq/acme-health.pdf
Ben L.: I'll start the KMS + peering checklist. Can ops provision a test VPC tomorrow? @Sarah T.
Sarah T.: Ops can open a ticket today; need contact from their infra. Once peering is scheduled, latency tests follow.

    return compute_semantic_accept(preds, gold)
